result.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
result.summary: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 EgoCaptioner，用「视频级概览＋带时间戳的分步叙述」格式做第一视角视频描述，构建粗到细标注流程得到 5 万条训练数据，并用事实性、覆盖度、步级时间对齐与冗余惩罚等多重奖励经 GRPO 精修描述。
AI.relevance_reason: 其奖励设计（事实准确、覆盖度、时间对齐、惩罚碎片化）与「用 pose 派生运动事实补充监督」可作为核查线索，考察能否用于监督 VLM 内部状态对细粒度视觉证据的保留与时间定位，但原文针对描述生成而非 latent 推理状态。
